items.title: 'People are furious': RBA deputy governor says more needs to be done on inflation

children.content: RBA deputy governor Andrew Hauser issues a warning that interest rates could rise further if the ongoing scourge of inflation does not come under control soon.

Mr Hauser says the Australian economy is "doing quite well" on issues of unemployment and real household incomes, but he singles out the continuing scourge of inflation as the nation's biggest problem.
